title: Add deterministic provider routing policy
prompt: Continue Phase 10 by adding a pure routing policy in src/ade/provider_router.py. Given a ProviderRegistry, RoutingRequest, and explicit availability snapshots, choose the first eligible provider deterministically. Availability must distinguish AVAILABLE, QUOTA_PAUSED, TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE, UNAUTHORIZED, and DISABLED. Never route to unauthorized or disabled providers. Quota/temporary states may be skipped for another eligible provider. If no provider is eligible return an explicit immutable decision rather than raising an opaque error. Add tests for preferred provider, quota fallback, temporary fallback, unauthorized exclusion, no candidate, and deterministic repeated selection. Export public API.
